title: Alberino's aid expedition to San Antonio de Pintoyaku
place_text: San Antonio de Pintoyaku, Peruvian Amazon

tellings.quote: Peru. This is the first time I was greeted by, you know, a small army of men with loaded shotguns.

plain: In 2023, the filmmaker Tim Alberino travelled to San Antonio de Pintoyaku, a remote village in the Peruvian Amazon, on an expedition to bring aid. Alberino, who was there, says that when he arrived he was greeted for the first time in his life by what he calls a small army of men holding loaded shotguns.
